name: Design
summary: Makes every agent in the project able to draw and revise screens, flows and diagrams on Relay's design canvas: a skill and standing rules for the design.* tools, so what an agent draws is laid out, named and easy for you to edit.
description: Turn it on for any project whose agents should sketch interfaces, flows or diagrams. Every agent launched there gets the design-canvas skill (how a design is pages of frames, text, shapes, icons, stickies, pen paths and pictures; auto layout, pinning and scrolling frames so screens lay themselves out without measuring text; ids an agent picks so one call builds a whole screen; copies, named colours and styles; motion keyframes; revising exactly the layers a person asked about; looking at the result with design.render; pictures through design.asset.add; and the craft that makes a mockup read as real — an 8 px rhythm, a type ramp, real copy, contrast) and the plugin's rules in its brief. The design.* tools work without it; the plugin is what makes the results good. The designs appear in the project's Design view as the agent draws them, tied to its terminal.
